title: Otho
lead: Marcus Salvius Otho, who had Galba killed on 15 January AD 69 and ruled until his suicide after the battle at Bedriacum in April. Tacitus brings him on as a ruined friend of Nero who turned to the soldiers when Galba passed him over (Histories of Tacitus 1:13, 1:21-25).

sections.b: Tacitus says Otho won Nero's favor by matching his luxury, was sent to Lusitania in Spain as governor after the affair over Nero's mistress Poppaea Sabina, and was the first to join Galba (1:13). Suetonius agrees that Nero sent him to Lusitania and says he governed with notable moderation and honesty (Otho 3). Wikipedia gives his birth as 28 April AD 32 and his reign as 15 January to 16 April 69. Josephus says Otho killed himself after the defeat at Bedriacum, having managed the public affairs three months and two days (Jewish War 4.9.9).
